tasks.title: Stopping distance
tasks.statement: Speed **{v} m/s**, delay **{l} s**, deceleration **{a} m/s²**, margin **{m} m**. Find the stopping distance (m).

tasks.title: Safe speed
tasks.statement: Reliable sensor range **{r} m**, margin **{m} m**, deceleration **{a} m/s²**, delay **{l} s**. Find the maximum safe speed (m/s).
tasks.solution: Solve v·L + v²/2a = R − margin: v = −aL + √((aL)² + 2a(R − margin)).
